breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting instructions regarding the numerical method. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction, as the detailed steps describe Strang splitting. The agent, however, incorrectly merged the conflicting information, stating to 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration within the Strang splitting framework,' which is not what the ground truth or the detailed instructions specify.
